xna-type.name: LeaderboardKey
xna-type.summary: Values used with LeaderboardIdentity.Create to select which leaderboard to access.
xna-type.remarks: Leaderboards are per title, and consist of the best scores or times for the player and his or her group of Xbox LIVE friends. Leaderboard data for other players is inaccessible.
